title: Core: Renderer - HiDPI canvas scaling and device pixel ratio
description: Unit tests for the HiDPI/devicePixelRatio handling in the canvas renderer. The renderer should set canvas.width = logicalWidth * dpr, canvas.height = logicalHeight * dpr, ctx.scale(dpr, dpr). Test initCanvas(canvas, width, height, dpr) at dpr=1 and dpr=2. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/hidpi.test.ts.
